narrative: This batch pins down previously fuzzy protocol and SDK surfaces with concrete, source-backed detail: A2UI's v0.9.1 wire protocol is now fully documented (four message types, transport bindings, catalog-agnostic envelope), AG-UI's package versions are registry-confirmed, and Effect's durable-execution semantics gained two concrete data points — the activity retry policy fix and a documented replay deadlock. The other thread is convergence on Effect as the orchestration foundation: OpenCode's V2 SDK is explicitly Effect-native, hosting the server in-process, which makes the factory toolchain's durable-orchestration layer directly consumable. Mastra extends its AI-SDK agnosticism to v7, and the generative-UI ecosystem keeps consolidating into monorepos (CopilotKit's with-mcp-apps archived in).

entries.title: Agentic SDLC factory toolchain
entries.summary: Effect's durable-execution surface gained the July 2026 recap's activity-retry-policy fix and SQL-backed persisted-queue fixes, and the OpenCode SDK V2 is now documented as Effect-native (in-process hosting), so the factory's orchestration layer is directly consumable. gh-aw's homepage wording drifted from "technical preview" to "Public Preview" — recorded as a wording change, not a material status change.

entries.title: Generative-UI ecosystem
entries.summary: A2UI's v0.9.1 spec now documents a concrete AG-UI transport binding, and AG-UI's release cadence is confirmed with exact NPM/PyPI/NuGet/Maven package versions. CopilotKit's monorepo consolidation added canvas-with-langgraph-python and with-mcp-apps examples.

entries.title: CopilotKit (generative-UI frontend stack)
entries.summary: `CopilotKit/with-mcp-apps` was archived and consolidated into the monorepo at `examples/integrations/mcp-apps`, tracking the MCP Apps integration into the same monorepo as the other generative-UI integrations.

entries.title: Effect
entries.summary: The durable-execution surface is partially closed: the official July 2026 recap confirms the activity retry policy fix and SQL-backed persisted-queue fixes, and issue #6014 documents a concrete Activity/Workflow replay deadlock with concurrent combinators. A third-party `backpine/durable-effect` package is added as a watchlist signal.

entries.title: Mastra agentic-UI integration
entries.summary: Mastra supported AI SDK v7 from its June 25, 2026 release day, extending its version-agnosticism beyond v4/v5. A changelog entry (@mastra/core@1.8.0) adds a supervisor pattern for multi-agent coordination, and a new community issue signals demand for standardized streaming/DX across Mastra's frontends.

entries.title: OpenCode
entries.summary: A new V2 SDK (beta) is Effect-native — `OpenCode.create()` hosts OpenCode in-process through an in-memory HTTP router, composing directly with Effect's durable-orchestration layer. A Python sibling client (`anomalyco/opencode-sdk-python`) was also added as ecosystem-traction evidence.

entries.title: OpenUI (Open Standard for Generative UI)
entries.summary: The OpenUI lab page lists five community integrations and plugins (Field Theory UI, Open WebUI Plugin, Ollama Integration, Genui VS Code Extension, OpenClaw OS Plugin), recorded as watchlist/saved-context.

entries.title: OpenWiki
entries.summary: A `langsmith` built-in connector was surfaced from the repo's source tree (src/connectors/sources/langsmith/), adding LangSmith trace/run evidence as a source — not enumerated in the README's connector count.

entries.title: t3code
entries.summary: Issue #2803 (image paste in remote web sessions) was re-surfaced, pinning T3 Code 0.0.24 as the repro baseline, and a second Arch AUR package (`maria-rcks/t3code-aur`) was added as a third-party packaging signal.

entries.title: Open Questions
entries.summary: The Effect durable-execution question narrowed — activity retry policy and a concrete replay edge case are confirmed, but the full @effect/workflow API surface remains un-retrieved. The generative-UI SDK versions question is partially answered: AG-UI package versions are registry-confirmed, while CopilotKit versions and A2UI v1.0 GA status remain open.

entries.title: A2UI (Agent to UI) Protocol
entries.summary: The complete v0.9.1 spec surface was retrieved: four server-to-client message types (createSurface, updateComponents, updateDataModel, deleteSurface), a transport contract requiring reliable ordered delivery and framing, six transport bindings (A2A, AG-UI, MCP, SSE+JSON-RPC, WebSockets, REST), and a catalog-agnostic envelope schema.

entries.title: AG-UI (Agent-User Interaction Protocol)
entries.summary: AG-UI is an open, lightweight, event-based wire protocol for streaming AI agent output to user-facing applications, standardizing how agents describe and stream UI over SSE, WebSockets, HTTP, and custom transports.

entries.title: Agent Client Protocol (ACP)
entries.summary: The Agent Client Protocol (ACP) is a standardized communication protocol between code editors and AI-powered coding agents, officially implemented in TypeScript by the @agentclientprotocol/sdk package; the spec repo also ships Rust/schema artifacts and GitHub Copilot CLI is an official ACP server.

entries.title: MCP Apps (Model Context Protocol Apps extension)
entries.summary: MCP Apps is the first official extension to the Model Context Protocol, co-developed by Anthropic and OpenAI, letting MCP servers deliver interactive UIs (charts, forms, dashboards) rendered securely in sandboxed iframes inside any compliant host — with a 5-phase UI lifecycle, ui:// tool-linked resources, JSON-RPC-over-postMessage communication, tool visibility, host theming/context, and display modes.

entries.title: Model Context Protocol (MCP)
entries.summary: The Model Context Protocol (MCP) is the open standard for how AI agents integrate with external tools, data sources, and other agents — JSON-RPC 2.0-based tools, resources, and prompts with capability negotiation, sampling, elicitation, authorization, and a 2026-07-28 revision that made the core stateless, added Multi Round-Trip Requests, header-based routing, cacheable list results, full JSON Schema 2020-12 for tool schemas, and a formal extensions framework and lifecycle policy. The 2026-08-22 "New MCP Roadmap" supersedes the March roadmap with five priority areas.

entries.title: Open Knowledge Format (OKF)
entries.summary: OKF is a minimal, vendor-neutral format for representing knowledge as markdown files with YAML frontmatter in a self-describing bundle — standardizing the small set of structural conventions (required type, provenance, trust, lifecycle, attestation) that make an agent-maintained knowledge corpus trustable. A growing ecosystem (okc, erd2okf, okf-gem, okf-mcp, openknowledge, okf-ingest, okf-skill, okf-lint, KSoR/KSP-001) and the standalone open-knowledge-format repo back the v0.2 spec.

entries.title: AI Knowledge Wiki Quickstart
entries.summary: Navigation and current status for the AI knowledge corpus — the Model Context Protocol (MCP) core and its 2026-07-28 stateless revision (revision, SDK posture, registry, extensions, the 2026-08-22 "New MCP Roadmap", and MCP Apps interface surface refreshed 2026-08-27), the Agent Host Protocol (AHP), Agent Client Protocol (ACP), the generative-UI / agent-UI protocol ecosystem (with the AG-UI Kotlin SDK and Cedar-OS deltas), the agentic SDLC factory toolchain (Pierre, t3code, Effect, OpenCode, Pi SDK, gh-aw CI workflows, and the followed blog feeds), and the agent-maintained knowledge-base layer (the Open Knowledge Format v0.2 spec and its growing producer/consumer ecosystem — okc, erd2okf, okf-gem/okf-mcp, AKB, openknowledge, okf-ingest, okf-lint, KSoR/KSP-001 — plus the OpenWiki CLI, 12+ model providers, OKF v0.2 output, v0.3.3 latest, that maintains this wiki; refreshed 2026-08-27 with the okf-lint linter, KSoR/KSP-001 standards adoption, the standalone open-knowledge-format repo, and a langsmith connector signal).

entries.title: Model Context Protocol releases
entries.summary: Versioned revision history of the Model Context Protocol specification and Tier 1 SDK posture — revisions 2025-03-26, 2025-06-18, 2025-11-25 (RC 2025-11-15), and the current stateless 2026-07-28 revision, plus the Java SDK v2.0.0 GA (tracking 2025-11-25), the TypeScript SDK v2.0.0 monorepo split, beta SDK versions for Go and C#, and companion-repo release trails (servers, swift-sdk, mcpb, registry).

entries.title: Recurring themes and trends
entries.summary: Compact index of recurring signals across the AI knowledge corpus — standardization and convergence of generative-UI / agent-UI protocols in 2026, MCP core standardization toward production infrastructure (stateless 2026-07-28 core, extensions framework, DCR→CIMD), the emerging agentic SDLC factory toolchain (including its CI-native gh-aw layer), and the emergence of agent-maintained knowledge-base formats and tooling (OKF v0.2, OpenWiki v0.3.3).
